description: This file defines the CaptureRateLimits enum containing static methods to clamp duration in milliseconds and frames per second (fps) values within specified ranges.

methods.name: clampDurationMs
methods.description: Clamps an optional duration in milliseconds within minMs and maxMs, using a default if nil.

methods.name: clampFps
methods.description: Clamps an optional fps value within minFps and maxFps, with a fallback to defaultFps if the value is not finite.
